Method of Attack: Malware delivered via spam emails disguised as bank transfer statements with attachments using double extensions (e.g., Swift_Copy.pdf.exe) that execute payloads dropping Visual Basic scripts and EXE files
Execution of dropped Visual Basic script on user login to run EXE file
Installation of keylogger to log keystrokes and mouse movements
Stealing browser, FTP, and email client databases including saved passwords, usernames, history, cookies, and cache
Stealing cryptocurrency wallet databases for multiple coin types
Impacted Systems: Cryptocurrency wallet applications for the listed coins
Attack Vector: Spam email attachments with double extension executable files
Indicators of Compromise: Dropped files: filename.vbs (Visual Basic script in Startup folder), filename.exe in %AppData%\Local\Temp\subfolder
Malware behavior: keylogger installation, credential theft from browsers, FTP, email clients, and cryptocurrency wallets
